title: Return, ii
logline: Tuesday. The dog, nine months older than the last strip, drawn as if the reader had seen every day of it. Gray at the muzzle now. The strip doesn't point.

panels.composition: The garage. BARNABY, eleven, on the floor in the light — the muzzle gray now, the walk to the bowl slower. WOOD at the table.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner digital flats, an old dog with a newly gray muzzle walking slowly to a bowl in a garage while a man draws at a table, no words
image.notes: Nine months off-page. The gray is new to the reader and not remarked.

panels.composition: The bowl. The dog eating. The gray.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, close-up of an old gray-muzzled dog eating from a bowl, no words

panels.composition: Wood, drawing him. The pad: the dog, gray. The first drawing of the gray.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a man drawing an old dog and the pad showing the dog with a gray muzzle for the first time

panels.composition: The dog under the table. The chin on the foot. The same as ever. The strip lets 'the same' be the point.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The gray, unremarked. The first drawing of it.
